caseNameFull: Goldwasser v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. Clarence N. Goodwin for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Samuel O. Clark, Jr., and Messrs. Sewall Key, J. Louis Monarch, and Bernard Chertcofj for respondent., Mr. Ewing Everett, as amicus curiae, filed a brief in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.
